name: Highly Casual | 5mg Seltzer | Lemon + Lime 1:1
description:
You think Lemon and Lime flavor is played out? You think you’ve tried every lemon lime flavored drink on the planet? Think again, amigo.

Our Lemon + Lime seltzer dances circles around your taste buds. It packs more flavor than Flavor Flave. It has more citrus punch than a prizefighting grapefruit
